summary: Computes the cross product of (a1 - a2) and (a3 - a2) into three doubles written to output a4, then normalizes by 1/sqrt(norm-squared). If norm-squared <= 0.0 (degenerate/collinear input) writes the double pattern 0.0, 1.0, 0.0 (1.0 encoded as dword 1072693248 at a4+12) and returns -1; otherwise returns 0. On the frame path, called by CollisionContactGenerationAndFrictionResponse (0x00436870) for collision contact face normal computation.

operations.description: v10 = *a1 - *a2, v11 = a1[1] - a2[1], v12 = a1[2] - a2[2]: per-component subtraction of the second triangle point (a2) from the first (a1), reading this+0x0, this+0x8, this+0x10
v13 = *a3 - *a2, v14 = a3[1] - a2[1], v15 = a3[2] - a2[2]: per-component subtraction of a2 from the third triangle point a3
Cross-product components stored to output: a4+0 = v4 = v11*v15 - v14*v12, a4+8 = v9 = v12*v13 - v10*v15, a4+16 = v5 = v14*v10 - v11*v13
v6 = v5*v5 + v9*v9 + v4*v4; if v6 <= 0.0 the three input points are degenerate/collinear (zero-sentinel constant dbl_59E430)
Degenerate branch: writes dwords a4+0=0, a4+4=0, a4+8=0, a4+12=1072693248, a4+16=0, a4+20=0 (doubles 0.0, 1.0, 0.0; 1.0 built from dbl_59E420) and returns -1
Normalization: v8 = 1.0 / sqrt(v6) (1.0 from dbl_59E420); writes a4+0 = v4*v8, a4+8 = v9*v8, a4+16 = v5*v8

clean_pseudocode: out[0] *= inv; out[1] *= inv; out[2] *= inv;
